title: Client Testimonials
content:
Never less than a 5-star review.

★★★★★
“Frank has been incredible to work with, especially in a tougher market for home purchases. His local knowledge and connections to the area are exceptional. He has always gone above and beyond, exceeding what I’ve experienced with other realtors. He’s honest, transparent, and a great advocate throughout the entire process.”— Michael, Grosse Pointe Park
★★★★★
“Frank did an outstanding job helping my husband and me find our first home in Grosse Pointe Farms. He was patient, knowledgeable, and communicated well. We can't recommend his services enough.”— Francesca, Grosse Pointe Farms
★★★★★
“Frank is a go-getter. He brings a lot to the table: knowledge, politeness, and the ability to move fast. He even brought us a buyer when we weren’t even selling! He knows the market inside and out.”— Jonathan, Grosse Pointe Shores
★★★★★
“My house was too big after my daughter went to college, and Frank priced it perfectly and got it sold quickly. He held an open house that provided the feedback I needed. He was fabulous to work with!”— Donna, Birmingham
★★★★★
“Frank did a very thorough marketing presentation combined with a market analysis to determine our strategy to sell. He is very professional in his approach and provided feedback on how best to stage our home. His knowledge of the local real estate market and standing in the community were a huge plus. A great experience working with him!”— Daniel, St. Clair Shores
★★★★★
“Frank was great as our real estate agent. Setting up house viewings and making offers was extremely easy, and he was incredibly helpful throughout the entire buying process. If I were to buy again, I’d definitely work with Frank!”— Tom, Harper Woods
